sentences.en: Certain things are easier to legalize than legitimize.
sentences.zh: 某些事情更容易实现合法化而不是正当化。

sentences.en: The new law aims to legitimize same-sex partnerships.
sentences.zh: 新的法律旨在使同性伴侣关系合法化。

sentences.en: They tried to legitimize their claim by providing historical evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们试图通过提供历史证据来为自己的主张赋予合法性。
